hypothesis: Over a Boolean world with a known invariant, a selector that keeps task information (H(Y|q(X))=0) and then minimizes description length recovers the ground-truth quotient, whereas pure description-length minimization collapses the obstruction and pure mutual-information maximization never compresses.

gates.REPSEARCH_MINIMAL_SUFFICIENT_RECOVERS_GR: The sufficient-then-compress selector recovers the exact ground-truth invariant in every task.
gates.REPSEARCH_MDL_ONLY_COLLAPSES_OBSTRUCTION: Pure description-length minimization always selects an insufficient quotient (H(Y|q(X))>0).
gates.REPSEARCH_ACCURACY_ONLY_NEVER_COMPRESSES: Pure mutual-information maximization always selects the identity (no compression).
gates.REPSEARCH_SUFFICIENCY_BEATS_ACCURACY_ON_: The minimal-sufficient quotient is strictly more compressed than the accuracy-only choice.

compute.sampling: exact enumeration of all 2**n worlds and all quotients in the lattice
